manifesto.title: Curiosity with method.
manifesto.p1: Technology changes faster than anyone can master it.
manifesto.p2: So I don't collect tools: I learn the one the problem asks for, and I learn it properly.
manifesto.p3: Every project leaves me with something I didn't know and a better solution than the last.

star.problem: A business doesn't know precisely how people move inside its store.
star.solution: A system that detects and tracks people by zone from one or several cameras using YOLOv8, and turns it into live KPIs, a heat map, dwell time per zone and exportable reports.
star.shotAlt: RetailVision Analytics monitoring dashboard with camera feed, real-time KPIs, zone distribution and heat map.

worlds.title: Other worlds
worlds.alfapet: Clinical management for a veterinary clinic: patients, appointments, history, inventory and sales, with role-based permissions and an RLS-protected database.
worlds.educore: Academic management for schools: enrollment, attendance, grades and report cards, built with PHP and PostgreSQL.
